desc: Derive reverse-process invariant: after deleting values > i, i is the P_i-th remaining element, so place i into the P_i-th empty final slot from N down to 1.
Implement fast stdin parsing and space-separated stdout writing.
Implement Fenwick add/prefix_sum and find_kth via binary lifting for leftmost prefix sum >= k.
Initialize Fenwick with 1 at every position and ans array of length N+1.
Run reverse placement loop i=N..1: pos=find_kth(P_i), ans[pos]=i, add(pos,-1).
Validate on samples and edge cases N=1, all P_i=1, all P_i=i; confirm O(N log N) time and O(N) memory.
